message.content: The decisive evidence is in: c1 is confirmed in-scope — a full 256-byte sweep against an independently computed FIPS 197 S-box shows 255/256 values wrong, including the contract's stated pairs (0→108 instead of 0x63, 0x53→85 instead of 0xed). The latest t16 probe shows tail masking is internally consistent (outputs conform to the kernel's own map at all edge lengths and surrounding bytes are preserved), so c2/c3 remain immaterial secondary aspects confounded by the global math defect. No new in-scope claims are warranted.
